notes.title: Update notes for Hotfix Version 1.03
notes.notes:
A tiny update, suggested by a player:

[list]
[*] When you unpause the game, there is no a short (0.5s) delay before the game restarts so you can find your character before you continue to fall!
[/list]

- Amicable Animal
